questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘Occurence’is ‘Occurrence’which means “the fact or frequency of something happening” घटना.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘Tangiable’is ‘Tangible’which means “perceptible by touch; clear and definite.” स्पर्शनीय, ठोस, वास्तविक.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can rectify the incorrectly spelt word in the following sentence.
The government has ordered for the maintainance of the roads.
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of ‘maintainance’ is ‘Maintenance’, which means “the process of keeping something in good condition” रखरखाव, संधारण।

questions.question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined out of which one word is misspelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
I felt absolutely (A) fit at the summit. My mind was absolutely clear.(B) I didn’t feel tired, I felt exhelarated. (C)It was a very clear sensation.(D)
questions.solution: A) The incorrectly spelt word is ‘exhelarated’which should be corrected to ‘exhilarated’, meaning “feeling very happy and excited” (बेहद प्रसन्न और उत्साहित).

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: C) The correct spelling of ‘Exhilerate’is ‘Exhilarate’which means “to make (someone) feel very happy, animated, or elated” उत्साहित करना, आनंदित करना.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: B) The correct spelling of ‘Preceed’is ‘Precede,’ which means “to come before something in time, order, or position.” पहले आना, पूर्व।

questions.question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.
You need to be concious enough to listen to the question.
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘concious’ is ‘conscious,’ which means “aware of and responding to one's surroundings” —जागरूक.

questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of ‘Eficient’ is ‘Efficient,’ which means “achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense” कुशल, दक्ष.

questions.question: Select the sentence that contains a spelling error.
options: The host institution must provide the delegates with accomodation at a subsidised rate.
The occurrence of the lunar eclipse is often a mystery for children
questions.solution: B) The sentence with a spelling error is B. The correct spelling of ‘accomodation’is ‘accommodation’, which means “a place to stay, especially in a hotel or other building” (रहने की व्यवस्था).

questions.question:

The resturant offers a wide variety of dishes
questions.solution: A) The incorrect spelling of ‘resturant’is ‘restaurant,’ which means “a place where meals are prepared and served to customers” (भोजनालय)

questions.question:
Select the correct spelling to fill in the blank.
The thought of eating half-cooked food under compulsion fills me with _____.
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of the word is ‘Repugnance’(option D), which means “intense disgust” or "strong feeling of dislike or opposition" (घृणा, विरोध).

A: Pleascence is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "pleasance”.B: Contredictions is a misspelling. The correct spelling is "contradictions.D: Futristic is misspelled. The correct spelling is "futuristic."

questions.question:

questions.question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.
Calder Hall is a nuclear power station in England which is known as the first nuclear power station to generate electricity for ___________ purposes.
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling is‘commercial’which means "related to or used for the buying and selling of goods and services" व्यावसायिक.

questions.question:
Select the correct spelling to fill in the blank.
When numerous ideas are presented in a historical context, more than mere ______ can be seen
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling is ‘Parallelism’(Option D), which means "the use of successive verbal constructions in poetry or prose that correspond in grammatical structure, sound, meter, meaning, etc." In Hindi, it translates to "समांतरता या समानता।"
